gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule C - Accrual Basis books that should be on cash basis; AJEs
gotchas.title: QuickBooks P&L is accrual; PY AJE never posted
gotchas.trap: Enter QuickBooks revenue $186,400 as gross receipts (includes the $9,800 A/R increase, e.g. the December HOA invoice collected 01/2026); or 'fix' tax depreciation to match the unposted books.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Tax return is cash basis (method used since 2016): gross receipts = revenue - increase in A/R = $176,600 (A/P nil). PY AJE #1 (2024 depreciation 8,486) was not posted, so QB retained earnings/accumulated depreciation do not roll to our PY workpaper - no return impact (tax depreciation comes from our Form 4562 schedule); re-send AJE to bookkeeper.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule C - Book-Tax Differences (meals, personal expenses, club dues, gifts)
gotchas.title: Personal and limited items buried in the books
gotchas.trap: Take the QuickBooks expense accounts at face value.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Remove country club dues $4,200 (sec. 274(a)(3)), Netflix $276, kids' soccer $640, 3 of 4 family phone lines $1,710; meals 50% ($1,570 allowed); gifts limited to $25 x 12 recipients = $300 (sec. 274(b)); truck expenses 85% business.
gotchas.impact: Sch C expenses overstated ~$10,000 if missed

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule C - De-Minimis Safe Harbor Election
gotchas.title: Mower under $2,500 vs used trailer
gotchas.trap: Capitalize the $2,300 mower on Form 4562 (or expense it without the election statement); expense the $6,500 trailer as a 'small tool', or depreciate it over 5 years without bonus.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Mower: de minimis safe harbor (Reg. 1.263(a)-1(f)) - expense on Sch C and attach the annual election statement. Trailer: used 5-year property acquired 03/22/2025 (after 01/19/2025) -> 100% bonus depreciation (automatic; chosen over sec. 179, which needs an election and is income-limited) on Form 4562 Part II. Truck: remaining MACRS from PERM schedule at 85%.
gotchas.impact: Timing; missing election statement = no safe harbor

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule C - Checking the top of Schedule C boxes (Form 1099 filed?)
gotchas.title: Helpers paid $8,000 and $4,500 by Zelle
gotchas.trap: Answer line I 'Yes' and line J 'No' (red flag) or 'Yes' without filing; ignore the filing obligation.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Advise client, obtain W-9s, file late 1099-NECs (filed via IRIS 09/18/2026; penalty exposure up to $340 per form under sec. 6721 plus $340 per payee statement under sec. 6722 for 2026-due returns - Rev. Proc. 2024-40 amounts), then answer I Yes / J Yes.

gotchas.title: PY prep fee paid personally in 2025
gotchas.trap: Omit it (not in the books) or deduct the full $1,650 on Schedule C.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Prorate by time: 1 of 3 hours on Sch C -> $550 to Sch C line 17 legal & professional; the personal 2/3 is nondeductible (misc. itemized deductions eliminated).

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule C - SEP IRA (compute maximum amount)
gotchas.title: SEP computed at 25% of net profit
gotchas.trap: Deduct 25% x net profit = $21,006 (the employee rate) - creates an excess contribution.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Self-employed rate is 20% of (net profit - 1/2 SE tax): 20% x $78,089 = $15,618; funded 09/22/2026 before the extended due date. QBI is reduced by the SEP deduction and 1/2 SE tax.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule C - S/E Health Insurance Deduction
gotchas.title: Spouse's employer offers subsidized family coverage
gotchas.trap: Deduct the $14,400 BCBS premiums on Sch 1 line 17 (or leave them in Sch C expenses as QuickBooks shows).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Carlos was eligible to participate in Mission Creek ISD's subsidized plan through Maria (district contributes to every tier) -> sec. 162(l)(2)(B) bars the deduction for all 12 months even though he declined. Premiums go to Schedule A medical, but itemized ($29,989) < standard ($31,500) -> no benefit.

gotchas.procedure_section: Scan - documents belonging to someone else; Dependents (qualifying relative)
gotchas.title: Rosa's SSA-1099 and 1099-INT in the PBC
gotchas.trap: Autoflow adds Rosa's $14,200 SSA-1099 and $85 interest to the Mendozas' return; or omit Rosa as a dependent because 'her SS is more than $5,200'.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Remove Rosa's documents from the return. Rosa is a qualifying relative: nontaxable Social Security is not gross income (gross income $85 < $5,200), Mendozas provide ~68% of support -> $500 credit for other dependents.

gotchas.title: Teacher's aide with $410 of receipts
gotchas.trap: Deduct $410, or deny because she is 'not a teacher'.
gotchas.correct_treatment: K-12 instructional aide with 900+ hours qualifies (sec. 62(d)(1)); deduction limited to $300.

engine_notes: Itemized deductions $29,989 (medical over 7.5% floor, sales tax + real estate tax, mortgage interest, charity) < standard deduction $31,500; standard deduction used.
